notes: Beginning with ch. 10 there is a difference in the form of the material contained in the book of Proverbs. No longer are there long admonitions, but the actual proverbs, short aphorisms dealing with right or wrong choices. Other than a few similar themes grouped together here and there, there is no arrangement to the material as a whole. It is a long collection of approximately 400 proverbs.
Heb “son.”

The imperfect tense describes progressive or habitual action, translated here with an English present tense. notes: Beginning with ch. 10 there is a difference in the form of the material contained in the book of Proverbs.
